title: Khalifa Trust Center
description: Continuously evaluated AWS security posture from Khalifa's security graph.
practices: Collection and evaluation run inside this deployment's own AWS account; posture data never leaves it.
Only statuses are published: no account IDs, resource identifiers, counts, or evidence appear on this page.
Workloads use least-privilege IRSA roles; runtime credentials live in Secrets Manager and reach pods through External Secrets.
Encryption at rest and in transit is verified continuously by the cited controls, for example ISO A.8.24 maps the encryption checks.

faqs.question: What is this page?
faqs.answer: A continuously updated view of the security posture Khalifa evaluates against this deployment's AWS configuration. It is not a certification or an audit report.

faqs.question: Why are no frameworks certified?
faqs.answer: Khalifa reports automated configuration posture only. Certification requires an independent audit, which this page never claims.

faqs.question: How fresh is this page?
faqs.answer: Assessments run continuously and the page is rebuilt nightly. When assessments stop, every framework unpublishes automatically.

footerNote: This page reflects automated configuration posture. It is not a certification or an audit report.
